name: the arctic and antarctica
description: the frozen ends of the earth, the last places humans reached.

events.text: permanent ice sheets begin to form on antarctica as the planet cools
the thule people, ancestors of the inuit, spread east across arctic canada to greenland, hunting whales from skin boats
vitus bering, sailing for russia, reaches alaska
russian and british expeditions make the first confirmed sightings of antarctica
roald amundsen's norwegian team is the first to reach the south pole
twelve countries sign the antarctic treaty, keeping the continent for peaceful science
